title: Tunisian Golden Bread Gratin
description: A crispy and savory Tunisian-style bread gratin, perfect as a side dish or snack.

ingredients.name: tunisian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and place in a large mixing bowl.
Drizzle the golden olive oil over the bread and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the Tunisian spices, salt, and pepper over the bread and toss again.
Transfer the bread mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the bread.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the bread is crispy.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
